_comment: Stem and beam ground truth, known BY CONSTRUCTION rather than counted by
eye: the sheet is engraved by LilyPond from the score in
reference-lines.ly, so these numbers follow from the notation itself and
A stem is one vertical stroke attached to a notehead — a chord of three
noteheads on one stem counts once. Whole notes have none. A beam is one
BAR, matching what line_detection.detect_beams counts: a beamed pair of
eighths is 1, a beamed group of four sixteenths is 2 (primary plus
Compared per staff over the whole page, not per cell: measure
segmentation is not stable across line thicknesses (at thickness 1 the
barline before the chord measure is missed and two measures fuse into one
cell), and a per-cell comparison would score that as a stem/beam error.
